stem: [反洗钱和反恐怖融资合规标准]以下哪两项分别直接对应2012年FATF 40项建议中的定向金融制裁和法人受益所有权透明度要求？(选择两项.)

options.A: 客户隐私法规应当指导尽职调查及其他预防洗钱和恐怖融资措施的制定.
options.B: 各国应努力实施与联合国安理会决议相一致的定向金融制裁.
options.C: 各国应采取措施确保法人受益所有权的透明度.
options.D: 各国必须采用完全相同且不得根据本国风险调整的统一框架,以预防和打击洗钱及恐怖主义融资活动.
options.E: 各国政府必须努力构建统一的行政和运作框架,以调查和起诉犯罪.

stem_en: Which two statements directly correspond to the 2012 FATF Recommendations on targeted financial sanctions and beneficial ownership transparency? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Customer privacy regulations should guide the development of due diligence and other money laundering and terrorist financing preventive measures.
options_en.B: Nations should work toward implementing targeted financial sanctions in alignment with United Nations Security Council resolutions.
options_en.C: Nations should take measures to ensure transparency of the beneficial ownership of legal persons.
options_en.D: Nations must adopt an identical, non-adjustable framework to prevent and combat money laundering and terrorist financing.
options_en.E: National governments must strive to build a uniform administrative and operational framework to investigate and prosecute crime.
